notes.title: Recall: Empty Wishes Launches on Steam
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that our partners have released a new 2D horror game titled [b][i]Recall: Empty Wishes[/i][/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775614/5f1e83ce3acd9fd28dc5cc5cf6a61afe852b4b20.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683270/Recall_Empty_Wishes/

Set in Taiwan during the 2010s, [i][b]Recall: Empty Wishes[/b][/i] is a story-driven interactive adventure that follows Yonny, a young woman searching for answers behind the mysterious disappearance of her brother, Tommy. As she delves deeper into the past, she encounters an eerie world where forgotten wishes take shape, leading her to relive fragmented memories from multiple perspectives of key characters connected to Tommy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775614/2dda5fe1dfad56f69ac215971681409fab9df2fe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775614/fe0af87cc82e7735a60b4490664051aa61ef71d1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775614/4fe05ff22d24395a756a521d3c706492a7d68285.png[/img]

[b]Story[/b]
When Yonny’s beloved brother, Tommy, vanishes without a trace, her determination to uncover the truth leads her to a surreal realm connected through an old toy phone receiver they used to play with as kids. This mysterious device allows Yonny and her friend, Phoebe, to delve into the memory echoes of key individuals tied to Tommy’s fate, revealing their deepest desires and secrets.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
Through interactive 2D side-scrolling gameplay, players will relive pivotal moments in the lives of key characters, unravel a tangled web of mystery and emotion, and uncover choices that shape the story’s haunting conclusion. With a unique blend of fantasy, mystery, and horror, Recall: Empty Wishes invites players into an emotional detailed narrative that explores the fragile boundaries of memory, truth, and longing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775614/fa6e9f5b4660c00a3aa1541c4777cac423f9b5b9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775614/3987c615f1cf0b6f88130920ab86db605dc9699e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775614/24971231b0ee53813a7146f2057f27ca53e3b2bc.png[/img]

[b]Features:[/b]
- Unravel a gripping psychological mystery set in Taiwan during the 2010s with a connective cast of characters and multiple endings.
- Experience the story through multiple perspectives, immersing yourself in different characters' memories.
- Explore a hauntingly beautiful world crafted with pixel-art backgrounds and hand-drawn portraits.
Solve environmental puzzles and interact with forgotten wishes to reveal hidden truths.

Inspired by story-driven games such as [i]To the Moon[/i], [i]The Coma[/i], and [i]Detention[/i], [b][i]Recall: Empty Wishes[/i][/b] is Puff Hook Studio’s first game project, and has received the following awards:
[list]
[*] Vision Get Wild PC Game 2021 - Bronze Award
[*] Bahamut ACG Award 2021 - TAICCA Special Award
[/list]
Recall: Empty Wishes will have a 10% launch discount for a limited time! Please check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775614/1058f2421238e81a96e00df92cb718a5f484d20c.gif[/img]

Hey, y'all!

Exactly one year has flown by since Loretta hit the Steam. It's been a whirlwind of events, balancing with the grind on our new project.

notes.title: Loretta - Indiecup
notes.content:
Hey!

I’m Yakov Butuzov and I’d like to present to you the game I’m working on — Loretta. It’s a psychological thriller that makes the player an accessory to the heroine’s crimes and leads her through a self-crafted nightmare.

And there’s a new demo available on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40263781/b676d046f1459636bb722ed7d3c0da8f3ea059fb.png[/img]

You could have already read my posts about the plot and the main inspirations for the game, so now it’s time to update you on the progress I made. I’m mostly making Loretta alone, so trying to understand the expectations of the audience is quite difficult, as well as corresponding to them. But I’d like to know what people want to get from the game like this and, hopefully, make it happen.

Loretta is a story-driven adventure game. Its gameplay focuses on choosing dialogue options, interacting with objects, and making decisions: planning the murder(s) and getting rid of the evidence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40263781/4b277457aa53d1666ab81640bdbed2d3af66acb8.png[/img]

There are several endings, too. You shouldn’t expect tremendous variability in such a game, but the most important thing for me is to give the player the possibility to either lead events into a thin web of dodgy lies or a series of murders that will push the heroine into the abyss of madness.

It’s the year 1947. Loretta and Walter Harris are moving to a farm. Into his parent’s house. Walter is a writer, Lora is a housewife. Both are quite unsuccessful. Moreover, Walter’s cheating.

Loretta starts to understand that she gave up her dreams, her job and her life for a failure of a husband she doesn’t even love. She finds herself in an empty cold house without a livelihood. And as she struggles to make loan payments, she finds out that Walter’s publishing house has insured his life. In case of his death or disappearance, the bank will pay out 30.000$. A plan is born in Lora’s mind.
So let me confess, I am in love with this era. Everything about it makes me love it passionately: the car design, interiors, clothes, "streamline" elements, culture, music (Bing Crosby, Al Jolson, Al Bowlly, The Ink Spots, Vera Lynn and others.)

However, Loretta is not a documentary. The name of the state in which the action takes place is not mentioned by design. It is a metaphysical place, refracted through the prism of Loretta's fading consciousness. You will be travelling through the hub of Loretta's memories, and you’ll have to solve a puzzle or a mini-game to unlock new parts of the story.
In the development, the main challenge for me is creating an unusual heroine. Loretta does horrible things during the game, and you can influence the severity of them. Each decision you make will have consequences.

Sooner or later in life, every person faces betrayal, poverty, and other challenges of fate. Everyone tries to settle them in their own way, but what if one goes all-in? Loretta dears to try.
It’s a story of a person fighting with their desires. It’s about frustration, lies, betrayal, relationships between man and woman, creativity, crimes, mysteries and even… love.
I’m not going to lie, the game turns out quite unusual. It has a distinctive style. II myself am slowly falling in love with the heroine, although she behaves like a damn brute. In the entire game, Loretta can kill fewer people than the main character of any shooter on the first level only. And my task here is to make the story feel exciting and interesting.

I invite you to play a free demo of Loretta on Steam and write a review. I read everything and will highly appreciate it as it will help me make the game better!
Thank you!

notes.title: Loretta and more about
notes.content:
Hello!

My name is Yakov Butuzov, and I am an indie game developer. I would like to present to you a game that I have been working on - Loretta.

Loretta is a psychological thriller that would make the player an accessory to the heroine’s crimes and would lead her through a self-crafted nightmare.

This story is about a woman, dealing with betrayal, her husband’s infidelity, relationships problems and difficult social situation of the 1940s.

Small teaser-trailer: https://youtu.be/ReWu9hMH1Es

Conceptually and aesthetically, the game is inspired by the American art of the twentieth century, the works of Andrew Wyeth and Edward Hopper, film noir of the 40s-50s, thrillers by Alfred Hitchcock, the Philip Ridley movie "The Reflecting Skin", the books "1922" by Stephen King and "Lolita" by Vladimir Nabokov.

Although it is usually difficult to pinpoint specific source of inspiration, I know it clearly for Loretta. 

One day I stumbled across "Christina's World".

The story of the "Christina's World" is rather melancholic, even scary, but it inspired me.

I wrote the first draft of the "story" in a few days. It was not a proper script, but sort of a synopsis. Then, to better understand the heroine, I wrote the story from her point of view. Although not essential for game development, this preliminary creative work, especially

in the beginning, allowed me to think through some of the nuances, and helped to unleash imagination.

For quite a long time I was enthralled by writing an ambiguous hero, even an anti-hero. Although not the most popular topic, it is probably one of the main challenges for me in "Loretta": to create a complex character, who, despite her evil actions, would evoke sympathy and understanding if not forgiveness.

Story

The year is 1947. Lora and Walter Harris move to a farm, which used to belong to his parents. Walter is a writer and Lora is a housewife. Both are quite unsuccessful.

The family is going through financial difficulties. The situation is also complicated by the fact that Walter owes money to people from New York. And although the husband keeps it a secret from his wife, Lora has a suspicion. Moreover, she suspects him of cheating.

Lora understands that she gave up her job, her dreams and other opportunities for her failure of a husband she doesn’t even love. Now she is stuck in a cold empty house barely making ends meet.

As she struggles to make loan payments, she finds out that Walter’s publishing house has insured his life. In the event of his death, the insurance sum would be 30.000$. A plan is born in Lora’s mind.

Loretta is a story-driven adventure game in which gameplay focuses on choosing phrases in dialogue, interacting with objects, and making decisions: planning the murder and getting rid of the evidence. 

Recently I released my first game. Its reviews helped me understand what players expect from games like that. Focusing on the plot and how the player’s actions affect it, it is essential to give a possibility to replay some moments, while avoiding complicated or distracting mechanics. The storyline may be extended by replaying certain episodes or the whole game. The game is being developed using GameMaker Studio 2, for РС at the moment. 

Loretta's sanity begins to suffer. This is reflected in the mini-games that take place in the Subconscious. Player is free to decide the fate of the character not only during the main game, but during mini-games, the result of which is also reflected on the plot.

I work on Loretta with Daria Shorohova - who is responsible for drawing characters and animation. Sometimes I hire freelancers for certain task, but most work I do myself.

I released my previous game DOM RUSALOK without a publisher, and got positive feedback from both journalists and players. Also, it gave me an opportunity to gather a small, but loyal audience.

Despite having studied epidemiology, I soon realized that I wish to dedicate my life to game development.

My social networks:

vk: https://vk.com/dom_rusalok_loretta

twitter: https://twitter.com/yabutuzoff

youtube: https://youtu.be/ReWu9hMH1Es

Sorry for my English, I'm from small Russian town and just learningh)

Thank you for your time!

Sincerely,  

Yakov Butuzov
